info.title: About {visa}
info.intro: Japan's Highly Skilled Professional program awards points for academic background, work experience, salary, research, language, and special conditions.
info.notice: This calculator is for {visa}. Requirements and interpretations may vary. Always check the official guidance.
info.description: Reach 70+ points to qualify. At 80+ points, additional preferential measures are available.
info.benefits.title: Preferential benefits
info.benefits.parentVisit: Parents may visit/long stay under conditions
info.benefits.housekeeping: Permission for domestic helper under conditions
info.categories.title: Point categories
info.pr.title: Permanent Residence (PR)
info.pr.description: Maintaining high scores can shorten the PR timeline.
info.pr.rule70: If you keep 70+ points → eligible after 3 years
info.pr.rule80: If you keep 80+ points → eligible after 1 year
info.pr.note: Actual eligibility depends on comprehensive review by immigration authorities.
info.license.title: Licenses and certifications

info.license.krAccepted: Some foreign certifications may be accepted; details vary.
